# **Experiment No. 3**

## **Experiment Title:**

Implement control structures and form validation; create a grading system based on user-entered marks.  

## **Software / Tools Required:**

1. Visual Studio Code (VS Code)  
2. Google Chrome  
3. HTML5  
4. JavaScript (ES6)

**Experiment Program Code (Grading System):**

\<\!DOCTYPE html\>

\<html lang\="en"\>

\<head\>

    \<meta charset\="UTF-8"\>

    \<meta name\="viewport" content\="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0"\>

    \<title\>Student Grade Calculator\</title\>

    \<link rel\="stylesheet" href\="prac3.css"\>

\</head\>

\<body\>

    \<div class\="main-wrapper"\>

        \<div class\="input-section"\>

            \<h2\>Grade Calculator\</h2\>

           

            \<div class\="form-group"\>

                \<div class\="row"\>

                    \<label\>Student Name:\</label\>

                    \<input type\="text" id\="studentName" placeholder\="Enter name"\>

                \</div\>

                \<div class\="row"\>

                    \<label\>Class/Grade:\</label\>

                    \<input type\="text" id\="studentClass" placeholder\="Enter class"\>

                \</div\>

            \</div\>

            \<h3\>Marks (0-100)\</h3\>

            \<div id\="subjectsContainer"\>\</div\>

            \<button onclick\="generateReport()"\>Generate Report\</button\>

            \<div id\="errorOutput" class\="error"\>\</div\>

        \</div\>

        \<div class\="output-section"\>

            \<div id\="reportOutput"\>

                \<div id\="placeholder" class\="placeholder-msg"\>

                    Fill in the details and click "Generate Report" to see the result here.

                \</div\>

            \</div\>

        \</div\>

    \</div\>

    \<script\>

        const subjects \= \["Math", "Physics", "English", "Chemistry", "Hindi", "Physical Education"\];

        const container \= document.getElementById("subjectsContainer");

        for (let i \= 0; i \< subjects.length; i\++) {

            container.innerHTML \+= \`

                \<div class="row"\>

                    \<label\>${subjects\[i\]}:\</label\>

                    \<input type="number" id="sub\_${i}" min="0" max="100" placeholder="0-100"\>

                \</div\>

            \`;

        }

        function getLetterGrade(marks) {

            if (marks \>= 95) return "O+";

            if (marks \>= 90) return "O";

            if (marks \>= 85) return "A+";

            if (marks \>= 80) return "A";

            if (marks \>= 75) return "B+";

            if (marks \>= 70) return "B";

            if (marks \>= 60) return "C+";

            if (marks \>= 50) return "C";

            if (marks \>= 40) return "D";

            return "F";

        }

        function generateReport() {

            const name \= document.getElementById("studentName").value.trim();

            const sClass \= document.getElementById("studentClass").value.trim();

            const errorOutput \= document.getElementById("errorOutput");

            const reportOutput \= document.getElementById("reportOutput");

            const placeholder \= document.getElementById("placeholder");

            errorOutput.classList.remove("visible");

            errorOutput.innerHTML \= "";

            if (\!name || \!sClass) {

                errorOutput.innerHTML \= "Please fill name and grade.";

                errorOutput.classList.add("visible");

                return;

            }

            let totalMarks \= 0;

            let subjectRowsHtml \= "";

            let hasFailed \= false;

            for (let i \= 0; i \< subjects.length; i\++) {

                const inputVal \= document.getElementById(\`sub\_${i}\`).value;

                const marks \= parseFloat(inputVal);

                if (inputVal \=== "" || isNaN(marks) || marks \< 0 || marks \> 100) {

                    errorOutput.innerHTML \= \`Invalid marks (0-100) for ${subjects\[i\]}.\`;

                    errorOutput.classList.add("visible");

                    return;

                }

                totalMarks \+= marks;

                if (marks \< 50) hasFailed \= true;

                subjectRowsHtml \+= \`\<li\>\<span\>${subjects\[i\]}\</span\> \<span\>${marks} \<small\>(${getLetterGrade(marks)})\</small\>\</span\>\</li\>\`;

            }

            const average \= totalMarks / subjects.length;

            const finalGrade \= getLetterGrade(average);

            const passed \= (\!hasFailed && average \>= 50);

            if(placeholder) placeholder.style.display \= 'none';

            reportOutput.innerHTML \= \`

                \<div class="report"\>

                    \<h3\>Report Card: ${name} (${sClass})\</h3\>

                    \<ul\>${subjectRowsHtml}\</ul\>

                    \<div class="final-row"\>

                        \<span\>Average:\</span\> \<span\>${average.toFixed(1)}\</span\>

                    \</div\>

                    \<div class="final-row"\>

                        \<span\>Final Grade:\</span\> \<span\>${finalGrade}\</span\>

                    \</div\>

                    \<div class="final-row" style="margin-top: 20px; border-top: 2px solid \#ddd; padding-top: 15px;"\>

                        \<span\>Status:\</span\>

                        \<span class="${passed ? 'pass' : 'fail'}"\>${passed ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL'}\</span\>

                    \</div\>

                \</div\>

            \`;

        }

    \</script\>

\</body\>

\</html\>

## **Grading System**

### **Accepts User Input Such As:**

1. Student Name  
2. Marks

### **It Displays:**

1. Grade (A, B, C, D or Fail)  
2. Validation Message  
3. Error Message for Invalid Input

## **Case Study Title:**

Password Validation Webpage using Form Validation and Control Structures

## **Case Study Program Code:**

**login.html (HTML and JS)**  
\<\!DOCTYPE html\>  
\<html lang\="en"\>  
\<head\>  
    \<meta charset\="UTF-8"\>  
    \<meta name\="viewport" content\="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0"\>  
    \<title\>Password Validation\</title\>  
    \<link rel\="stylesheet" href\="login.css"\>  
\</head\>  
\<body\>  
\<div class\="login-box"\>  
    \<h2\>Password Validation\</h2\>  
    \<form id\="loginForm"\>  
        \<label\>Username\</label\>  
        \<input type\="text" id\="username" placeholder\="Enter Username"\>  
        \<label\>Password\</label\>  
        \<input type\="password" id\="password" placeholder\="Enter Password"\>  
        \<button type\="submit"\>Login\</button\>  
    \</form\>  
    \<p id\="result"\>\</p\>  
\</div\>  
\<script\>  
    document.getElementById("loginForm").addEventListener("submit", function(event) {  
    event.preventDefault();  
    const username \= document.getElementById("username").value;  
    const password \= document.getElementById("password").value;  
    const result \= document.getElementById("result");  
    try {  
        if (username \!== "1043") {  
            throw "Invalid Username\! Username must be 1043.";  
        }  
        if (password.length \< 8) {  
            throw "Password must be at least 8 characters long.";  
        }  
        if (\!/\[A-Z\]/.test(password)) {  
            throw "Password must contain at least one uppercase letter.";  
        }  
        if (\!/\[a-z\]/.test(password)) {  
            throw "Password must contain at least one lowercase letter.";  
        }  
        if (\!/\[0-9\]/.test(password)) {  
            throw "Password must contain at least one number.";  
        }  
        if (\!/\[\!@\#$%^&\*(),.?":{}|\<\>\]/.test(password)) {  
            throw "Password must contain at least one special character.";  
        }  
        result.style.color \= "green";  
        result.innerHTML \= "Login Successful ✅";  
        setTimeout(function () {  
            window.location.href \= "prac3(2).html";  
        }, 1000);  
    }  
    catch(error) {  
        result.style.color \= "red";  
        result.innerHTML \= error;  
    }  
});  
\</script\>  
\</body\>  
\</html\>

## **Result / Conclusion**

The practical was completed successfully. The concepts of **control structures** and **form validation** were implemented. A grading system was developed that accepts user input, validates the entered marks, and displays the appropriate grade accurately using JavaScript.
